quotes.text: I was the one who turned her into Tina Turner. I had to tell her how to dress, how to walk and how to talk on stage. I told her how to stand and how to look, the whole thing, man, I mean from the wig down.
I write a new song every day. Man, I'm always doing something creative. I like to design things, like Tina's clothes, for instance. One time I designed a dress for her with a tail on it, man.
There's no one else to tell them the story because everyone is gone. I got involved with [the musical] and now I feel proud of it.
